items.statement: Every engine firing: consolidated PAT +34%, ROE 23%; Auto (+21%) and Farm (+15%) held margins through a 450 bps commodity hit; Mahindra Finance PAT +78%, Tech M +28%, Growth Gems +3x.
items.quote: Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd | Q1 FY27 earnings call, 30 Jul 2026 | Sector: Auto / Diversified | Anish Shah (Group CEO & MD), Rajesh Jejurikar (Auto & Farm). 1. The one-line verdict "Every engine in our federation is firing." A genuinely broad-based beat — the auto/farm core held margins against a brutal commodity shock while the financial-services and "Growth Gems" engines delivered the su

items.statement: Mahindra's real estate business achieved robust growth in gross development value additions and residential pre-sales during the quarter.
items.quote: Robust GDV additions Rs 5.6K cr.,  60% Solid Resi pre-sales Rs 925 cr.,  2x Strong execution … OCs delivered before plan

items.statement: The company noted that rural labor shortages and higher industrial wages are driving a structural shift toward mechanization, supported by healthy Rabi cash flows.
items.quote: Rural labour shortages & higher industrial wages led to structural shift toward mechanization Healthy Rabi cash flows; procurement of wheat in the Rabi season up by 19% YoY

items.statement: The company plans to create additional capacity in Chakan and has announced a greenfield plant in Nagpur to support future launches.
items.quote: Creating additional NU_IQ capacity in Chakan of 10k p.m. (92k operational capacity by F28 exit) Greenfield plant announced in Nagpur for F29 & beyond to support new launches

items.statement: The demand environment in rural areas is expected to benefit from a strong monsoon recovery and accelerated Kharif sowing.
items.quote: Rainfall deficit improved sharply to -15%2 indicating a strong monsoon recovery Kharif sowing accelerated significantly with acreage at 79 million ha2

items.statement: The core tractor business maintained a robust margin of 19.2% despite experiencing hikes in commodity prices.
items.quote: Sustained a robust 19.2% margin in the core tractor business amid commodity price hikes

items.statement: Higher industrial wages and shortages of rural labor have contributed to a structural shift toward mechanization.
items.quote: Rural labour shortages & higher industrial wages led to structural shift toward mechanization

items.statement: The automotive segment achieved a margin of 8.9% despite experiencing steep commodity inflation.
items.quote: Q1: AUTO (SUV & LCV) MARGINS Margin of 8.9% despite steep commodity inflation

items.statement: The company has announced a new greenfield plant in Nagpur to support launches from fiscal year 2029 onwards.
items.quote: Greenfield plant announced in Nagpur for F29 & beyond to support new launches

items.statement: Mahindra is creating an additional 10,000 per month capacity in Chakan to reach 92,000 operational capacity by the end of fiscal year 2028.
items.quote: Creating additional NU_IQ capacity in Chakan of 10k p.m. (92k operational capacity by F28 exit)

items.statement: Tech Mahindra achieved large deal wins with a total contract value of 1,078 million dollars, representing a 33% increase.
items.quote: Large deal wins … TCV $1,078mn., 33% Margin expansion … EBIT 14.4%, 330bps Free cash flow $167mn., 94%

items.statement: The company has deployed AI initiatives like Samur.AI and xSell.AI to process loan files and lower acquisition costs.
items.quote: Samur.AI • 65% loan files processed by AI agents in July xSell.AI • 30% lower cost of acquisition for AI orchestrated channel

items.statement: The electrification level in the L5 category reached 40.2% during the first quarter of fiscal year 2027.
items.quote: Market Leadership in E-3W with 39.5%1 MS in Q1 F27 L53 Electrification is at 40.2% in Q1 F27

items.statement: The company's forward-looking statements regarding future growth prospects involve various risks and uncertainties.
items.quote: Certain statements with regard to our future growth prospects are forward-looking statements, which involve a number of risks and uncertainties

items.statement: positive
items.quote: Finance & Tech … accelerating momentum Mahindra Finance … PAT 78%, GS3 3.45%, disbursements 22% TechM … PAT 28%, revenue momentum & margin expansion

items.statement: Mahindra Finance's profits increased by 78% due to improvements in asset quality, technology, and data.
items.quote: Mahindra Finance has had 2 or 3 very good quarters. This time profits up 78% and driven by a lot of things that we wanted to have in place

items.statement: The real estate business grew its gross development value by 60% and doubled its free sales this quarter.
items.quote: Real estate, this quarter has added ₹5,600 crores of GDV, up 60%. Free sales number ₹925 crores, up 2x.

items.statement: The logistics business has successfully turned around from a period of poor execution and losses.
items.quote: Logistics has gone from reverse gear to a positive gear now. Logistics was a business that wasn’t doing very well, we talked about it, execution was poor.

items.statement: The automotive segment's margins declined compared to the previous year due to high commodity price increases.
items.quote: Now, of course, we have lost margin compared to last year and we can talk more about that in the Q&A, but we believe this is a reasonably good margin performance

items.statement: The tractor business faces a challenge in the upcoming quarter due to a year-over-year shift in volume mix.
items.quote: I think Rajesh has explained that one of the challenges we'll have in second quarter is the volume mix shifting from second to third quarter, just when you look at year over year.

items.statement: Management expects the automotive segment to maintain its resilient performance in the upcoming quarters despite margin pressures.
items.quote: The resilient performance continues for the coming quarters, in spite of pressures on margins, as you have heard from all the presenters.

items.statement: Management expects to maintain or slightly improve the operating profit margin sequentially in the second quarter if commodity prices remain stable.
items.quote: So, sequentially if there is no further dramatic change in commodities from where we are, we think we should be able to maintain/slightly improve the Operating Profit margin between Q1 and Q2.

items.statement: Tech Mahindra is on track to achieve a 15% EBIT margin by the end of the fiscal year.
items.quote: we get to 15% EBIT margin and then we talk about the next phase as we go from there.

items.statement: Mahindra Lifespaces aims to reach 10,000 crores in pre-sales by the fiscal year 2030.
items.quote: And we codified that we want to be a 10,000 crores company pre-sales by FY30.

items.statement: The company is experiencing robust demand momentum in both urban and rural markets, along with a shift toward diesel vehicles.
items.quote: We have seen very strong demand momentum, urban and rural both. We are seeing some kind of a shift to diesel.

items.statement: The company implemented an aggressive price increase to avoid the disruption of frequent incremental price hikes for customers.
items.quote: We have consciously taken, what we may call a slightly aggressive price increase. We normally are more conservative but really the thinking was it's very disruptive to customers

items.statement: The automotive team implemented price hikes of 1.5% and an average of 2.7% in mid-July to offset commodity inflation.
items.quote: The team has taken, like you rightly pointed out, around 1.5 earlier and 2.7 on average in towards the mid of July.

items.statement: The farm business continues to face cost pressures from unhedgeable steel and rubber price increases.
items.quote: Farm will continue to have some pressure because of what we saw in steel and rubber, steel is up now 24% and rubber is up 30%, 53% from the beginning of the calendar year.

items.statement: The automotive segment's margins were impacted by significant commodity price increases over the past several months.
items.quote: but we believe this is a reasonably good margin performance, which has been on the back of a very high commodity price increase, which we have seen over the last many months

items.statement: The automotive and farm segments demonstrated resilience despite a commodity price impact of 400 to 500 basis points.
items.quote: Auto and Farm resilience in a strong quarter despite commodity price impact of 400 to 500 basis points. Auto profits up 21%, Farm up 15%.

items.statement: The tractor business has demonstrated the ability to maintain margins between 17% and 19% regardless of industry or commodity cycles.
items.quote: And that is the ability of the business to manage, either the up cycle that may happen for an industry or in spite of a down cycle or commodity cycles up or down.

items.statement: The company expects to reach an internal combustion engine SUV capacity of 60,000 units per month by September.
items.quote: We had said by September we'll be at 60,000 per month, which we should be ready with by September, which is the end of first half.

items.statement: The first phase of the Nagpur capacity expansion is scheduled to be ready in the first half of calendar year 2029.
items.quote: The first phase of Nagpur should be ready first half of calendar 2029. So that's what you see in the first bullet point there, which is 20,000

items.statement: The aerostructures business has secured $1.2 billion in cumulative contract wins, with half of that amount won in the last year.
items.quote: $1.2 billion of cumulated contract wins, half of them in the last year alone at 600 million.

items.statement: The company plans to launch several new vehicle models soon using the NU_IQ platform.
items.quote: The NU_IQ platform will start delivering models fairly soon and we will have a number of new models coming out from there.

items.statement: The integration of SML is expected to create significant value and enhance competitiveness for the truck and bus division.
items.quote: And as we now brought SML on board, we feel even more confident that we can create very meaningful value in this business going forward

items.statement: The light commercial vehicle and bus industry offers a substantial revenue and profit pool.
items.quote: It's an industry with a very high revenue pool, very high profit pool. Of course, we have a mixed bag of products.

items.statement: Extreme weather events, such as heavy rains, present operational challenges and disrupt production schedules.
items.quote: And that's why it is a challenging environment to navigate. I mean, I was avoiding wanting to say this, but we lost 3 days in July because of the rains.

items.statement: positive
items.quote: Overall, I would say, that we are on balance cautiously optimistic as well.
